notes: Profile: mid-market helpdesk SaaS serving EU retailers + logistics — heavy Zendesk + Freshdesk integrations.
Primary problem: noisy ticket volume, long TL;DRs for agents, manual tag routing misses ~18% of escalations.
Said on call (CTO): 'We need summaries that are consistent across agents and robust during Black Friday spikes.'
Proof of value ask: 2-week POC -> improve first-response synthesis + auto-tag precision to >85% on top 20 tags.
Preferred models: cost-sensitive (Llama-derived or quantized Falcon); they will accept Redwood-verified variants.
Latency targets: summary generation < 600ms p50 for short emails (<= 400 tokens); fallback routing < 200ms decision latency for macro triggers.
Throughput targets: baseline 8k tickets/day, design for 60k/day peak window (spikes), burst handling without >10% error rate.
Integration needs: Zendesk macros, Freshdesk workflows, webhook tool-calls to internal ticket enrichment service, ability to write tags to custom fields.
Data controls: EU data residency required for production tenancy, SSO + SCIM for users, audit logs retained 1 year for SOC2 compliance.
POC scope agreed: ingest 1 month of historical tickets (anonymized), run live shadow mode for agent assist, evaluate auto-tagging precision/recall, and run load test with synthetic spike generator.
Security: asked for KMS integration and key rotation schedule; legal requested example DPA & SCCs prior to production.
Cost sensitivity: CPU-heavy mid-size models preferred in dedicated pools; open to Optimize recommendations for quantization and caching to reduce token costs.
SE notes (Marco): demo showed streaming summary + one-click macro suggestion. Agent toolbar hooks and 'apply suggested tags' buttons required.
Recent ask from Product: ability to export summaries to agent notes as a single-line subject + 3-bullet body (for macro templates).
Quote from CSM prospect: 'If auto-tagging drops our triage costs by 30% and reduces manual routing, procurement greenlights.'
Decision makers: CTO (security + infra), Head of Support Ops (use-case owner), VP of Product (integration/UX).
Procurement timeline: legal review in parallel — target sign by 2026-05 if POC meets SLA/cost goals.
Misc stubs: Jira backlog referenced in call: SUP-4712 (POC onboarding), SEC-9981 (security questionnaire).
Helpful artifacts: Drive pricing deck, security Q&A doc linked above. Gmail thread contains transcripts + sample ticket exports (thread id above).

requirements_summary: Ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging to feed Zendesk/Freshdesk workflows. Must support tool-calls for enrichment, macros application, and operate reliably during sales/holiday spikes. Strong security controls (SAML, audit logs, EU residency). POC should demonstrate accuracy >85% on top tags and throughput resilience to 6-8x baseline traffic.
poC_details: 2-week, staging in EU. Tasks: historical data ingest (anonymized), shadow-live results to agents, integrate to Zendesk macros endpoint, run synthetic spike tests, measure latency/accuracy/cost. Success criteria: tag precision >85%, summary quality score >4/5 in agent review sample, sustained 99.5% availability under spike test.
